Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Yep—orders can sometimes be canceled after they’re placed, but only if they haven’t been fulfilled yet. Once an order has been processed, shipped, or has tracking added, it’s no longer eligible for cancellation.

If you want, send me your order number or checkout email and I can check whether your order still has a shot at being canceled 🙂
